heading: ## Mutation-sweep recipe — numbered steps; bounded cold-read evidence

findings.quote: 8–12 defects, at least one per class (two of the JS ten share a class — the :47-48 pair — and the bash exemplar's :70-71 pair does the same)
findings.why: The kimi note's own class accounting shows a second shared-class pair in the JS ten — D1 and D2 both read `off-by-one count` and its by-class tally is `off-by-one 1/2` — so four of the ten share a class, not two, and the parenthetical names only the :47-48 pair.

The model range skips §2 (lines 80-107), the only place the kimi note carries the survivor-probe `O (non-equivalence)` results that step 8 of this same section cites at :82-99, so the cited model does not cover the `survivor probes` element of the list it is attached to while the kagi range (§1-§7) does include its §2.
